demos.title: Form builder (default skin)
demos.description: Draft editing, publish, lifecycle state and the public link, plus the door to the form's settings. Reorder buttons at the ends of the list are gated with the reason beside them rather than greyed out for no stated cause, and a kind the deployment does not recognise stays listed and says why it cannot be configured — dropping it would silently delete a field from a stored schema.

A widget the skin does not implement — including one a future stapel-attributes release adds — degrades to a named explanation instead of a control that would write a wrong shape into a published schema.

demos.title: Forms list (default skin)
demos.description: The workspace's forms with the two acts the builder does not own: configure who gets told about a response, and delete. The delete confirmation is one SkinConfirm for the whole list — a bottom sheet on a phone — and it names the consequence, because deleting an open form stops its public link resolving immediately.

A load that SUCCEEDED and found nothing — the designed empty state, with the one action that resolves it.

demos.title: Responses (default skin)
demos.description: Answers as their own version asked them: a submission records WHICH schema it answered, so reviewing an old response shows the questions that were actually put, not today's. Deleting and resending sit behind forms.responses.manage — the capability stapel-forms projects — so a host that declares the caller's grants gets the write block switched off with the permission NAMED beside it, and a host that declares nothing keeps it live and lets the server answer. An ERASED row is gated the same way. A refusal and an outage are drawn as different states: a 403 is a decision and offers no retry, a 503 says it is on our side and does.

variants.description: Two responses to version 3, with the per-question columns.
A load that SUCCEEDED and found nothing — never an empty grid, which reads as 'nobody answered' even during an outage.

demos.title: Form settings (default skin)
demos.description: Who gets told when a response arrives, and how long responses are kept. Destinations are not validated here — the server accepts what it accepts, so an address that does not look like one is a notice beside the field, never a refusal. The retention ceiling is a deployment setting no client can read, so a too-long override comes back as the server's own error.400.forms_invalid_retention rather than a guessed number.

variants.description: A form whose responses reach a real inbox.
Nothing configured: the pane states the consequence — responses stored, nobody told — instead of leaving two empty inputs that look finished.

demos.title: Public form (default skin)
demos.description: A published schema rendered as a form: one antd widget per stapel-attributes kind, the admin's own labels, and a submit bar whose blocked reason is text beside the button rather than a tooltip a disabled control can never show.

variants.description: Seven kinds at once — header, text, long text, select, number, boolean, date.
The LOUD fallback: a kind this build cannot draw gets a notice in the field's place AND blocks the submit, naming the kind. Dropping a possibly-required field silently is the failure this replaces.
